title: WhiteMatter Raises $20 Million in Series A Funding
content_md: Cybersecurity startup WhiteMatter on Tuesday announced raising $20 million in a Series A funding round that brings the total raised by the company to $24 million. The investment round was led by Blumberg Capital, with additional support from previous investors Crew Capital and Sprout & Oak. Founded in 2024 and previously known as QuilrAI, WhiteMatter has built a platform that helps organizations secure and govern every AI agent running in their environments. According to WhiteMatter, enterprises can run every AI agent through its platform and gain visibility into where agents are built and used: across endpoints, cloud, SaaS, and code. The solution deploys and governs every agent, model, and MCP server, observes and secures each action, and optimizes traffic through a single gateway. WhiteMatter can deploy a dedicated guardian agent for every agent running in the environment, scaling if agents multiply autonomously, to ensure continuous policy-driven control. The cybersecurity startup will use the new investment to accelerate research and development and expand its go-to-market organization. It will also build its executive team. “Despite all the discussion about pausing AI development, enterprises are doing the opposite.
